title: Trusted colleagues report firsthand encounters with beings

tellings.quote: sounds, the most trusted people in my circle that I have worked with and do work with um have those speak to having those firsthand experiences with.

plain: A helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he flew a UFO recovery mission, tells Michels that the most trusted people he has worked with, and still works with, describe having had their own firsthand experiences with non-human beings. He does not name them or say what they saw. He offers it as support from people he trusts, not as something he witnessed himself.
